summary.goal: Add Context tab to PlanEditorPage showing formalized role decisions using freeform key-value editing (dynamic roles, dynamic fields)
summary.context: Context bridges understanding (observations) and specification (implementation). Schema is freeform: Record<string, Record<string, unknown>> - any role key, any fields. Suggested roles and fields are documented for agent prompts but not enforced by UI or schema. The UI uses dynamic tabs with KeyValueEditor, matching the schema-context approach.
summary.freeform_rationale: Different roles think differently, orgs have different needs. PlannerLead spawns specialist agents dynamically. The Orchestrator is an LLM that can understand any JSON structure. Intelligence lives in agent prompts, not UI forms.

acceptance_criteria.description: PlanEditorPage shows Plan | Understanding | Context tabs
Context tab shows one tab per role key in context + '+' button at end
'+' button opens AddRolePopover with suggested roles and custom role input
Each role tab uses KeyValueEditor for freeform field editing

Delete role option in role tab dropdown (with confirmation)
